# Probes of the v2 law reference: the same file is read by scripts/law_ref_v2_reference.py
# (an independent implementation in standard-library Python) and by tests/law_ref_v2.rs.
# `ref` probes give a reference to encode and its bytes and law id; `reject` probes give
# bytes a reader must refuse and the reason. Names and strings are written as UTF-8 hex.
